title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 21: the king's heart in Yahweh's hand, justice over sacrifice, and victory from Yahweh.

questions.text: In whose hand is the king's heart, like the watercourses?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:1 says the king's heart is in Yahweh's hand like the watercourses; he turns it wherever he desires.

questions.text: What does this chapter say is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:3 says to do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

questions.text: According to this chapter, where is it better to dwell than to share a house with a contentious woman?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:9 says it is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

answers.text: In the corner of the housetop

questions.text: What happens to whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:13 says whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

answers.text: His house will be uprooted by Yahweh
His riches will sprout wings and fly away
He will also cry out, but shall not be heard
He himself will fall into a deep pit

questions.text: What does this chapter say about he who loves pleasure?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:17 says he who loves pleasure will be a poor man; he who loves wine and oil won't be rich.

answers.text: He will be a poor man

questions.text: Where does this chapter say it is better to dwell than with a contentious and fretful woman?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:19 says it is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

questions.text: What does whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keep his soul from?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:23 says whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

questions.text: Why does the desire of the sluggard kill him, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:25 says the desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

answers.text: Because he loves sleep more than bread
Because his hands refuse to labor

questions.text: What does this chapter say exists against Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:30 says there is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

answers.text: No wisdom nor understanding nor counsel

questions.text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle, but with whom is victory?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:31 says the horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is with Yahweh.
